# Draft:List of international presidential trips made by Mohamed al-Menfi

Mohamed al-Menfi has made numerous public international trips to several countries as Chairman of the Presidential Council of Libya since 15 March, 2021.
Summary
The number of visits per country where al-Menfi has traveled are:
* One: Bahrain, Brazil, China, Republic of the Congo, Greece, Kenya, Nigeria, Russia, Spain and Turkmenistan.
* Two: Azerbaijan, Italy, Qatar and Turkey.
* Three: Algeria and Ethiopia.
* Four: France, Saudi Arabia and Tunisia.
* Five: United States.
* Twelve: Egypt.
